hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: The majority of the crypto signals sit in a stressed cross‑asset regime with negative composites, elevated volatilities and non‑trivial expected shortfalls. Core assets (BTC, ETH, SOL, LTC) show flat or modestly negative signals and modest conviction, suggesting limited upside and heightened downside risk. The long‑biased altcoins lack any volatility or alpha data, making their signals fragile and speculative. Overall the portfolio should tilt toward a defensive stance, scaling back exposure across the board.
